```{r library}
source("plot_theme.R")
source("save_pub.R")
```

# parameter
```{r parameter}


# ============================================================
# 4. Bar parameters
# ============================================================

bar_width <- 0.60

# Distance between the two dodged bars within each Situation.
bar_interval <- 0.70

# Bar outline thickness.
border_size <- 4

bar_position <- position_dodge(width = bar_interval)


# ============================================================
# 5. Paired subject line parameters
# ============================================================

paired_line_color <- "#A0A0A0"
paired_line_linetype <- "longdash"
paired_linewidth <- 1.50

paired_point_color <- "#A0A0A0"
paired_point_size <- 3

# ============================================================
# Individual point parameters
# ============================================================

point_shape <- 21
point_size <- 15
point_alpha <- 0.30
point_stroke <- 4
point_color <- NA

# ============================================================
# 6. Error-bar parameters
# ============================================================

errorbar_width <- 0.20
errorbar_linewidth <- 2.50


# ============================================================
# 7. Significance annotation parameters
# ============================================================

# Vertical distance between Outcome-8 mean and significance line.
sig_y_offset <- 6

# Vertical distance between significance line and text.
sig_text_margin <- 0.20

sig_label_uncertain <- "***"
sig_label_certain <- "***"

sig_text_color <- "black"
sig_size <- 30

sig_segment_color <- "black"
sig_seg_size <- 1

# Significance line positions above the two bars within each Situation.
sig_uncertain_x_start <- 0.825
sig_uncertain_x_end <- 1.175
sig_uncertain_x_center <- 1.000

sig_certain_x_start <- 1.825
sig_certain_x_end <- 2.175
sig_certain_x_center <- 2.000


# ============================================================
# 8. Color palettes
# ============================================================

bar_fill_alpha <- 0.20
point_fill_alpha <- 0.30

outcome_color_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#4F81BD",
  "Outcome-8" = "#D97742"
)

bar_fill_palette <- c(
  "empty" = NA,
  "Outcome-2" = scales::alpha("#9DC3E6", bar_fill_alpha),
  "Outcome-8" = scales::alpha("#F3B082", bar_fill_alpha)
)

bar_color_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#4F81BD",
  "Outcome-8" = "#D97742"
)

point_fill_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = scales::alpha("#4F81BD", point_fill_alpha),
  "Outcome-8" = scales::alpha("#D97742", point_fill_alpha)
)


# Let bars touch the x-axis.
y_expand_lower <- 0

# Keep a little top space for significance labels.
y_expand_upper <- 0.03
```

# EXP1
```{r data directory}

data_dir <- file.path("..", "figs_data", "EXP1_CGB_data_260312.xlsx")
```


## Gratitude
```{r EXP3_PMPD Gratitude}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = '02_condi_long')
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome != "Outcome-5", ]
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation != "Ambiguous", ]

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp1】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Rating, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Rating, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')
# 
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(exp_data, dv = "Rating", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Outcome")) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Situation")) %>%
  EMMEANS("Outcome", by = "Situation") %>%
  EMMEANS("Situation", by = "Outcome") 

```


### fig
```{r, echo=TRUE}
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\03_exp1_grati_situation_avova_260613.svg"

# ============================================================
# 3. Axis labels and y-axis
# ============================================================

x_title <- "Situation"
y_title <- "Gratitude-Cost"

y_min <- 0
y_max <- 115
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 100
y_break_by <- 20


sig1_y <- 99
sig2_y <- 99
sig3_y <- 105
sig_seg_margin <- 1.5

# ============================================================
# 2. Data columns and factor settings
# ============================================================

sub_col <- "SubID"
dv_col <- "Rating"

situation_levels <- c("Uncertain", "Certain")
outcome_levels <- c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8")

# situation_labels <- c(
#   "Uncertain" = "Uncertain-\nto-Certain",
#   "Certain" = "Constantly-\nCertain"
# )
situation_labels <- c(
  "Uncertain" = "Uncertain",
  "Certain" = "Certain"
)
outcome_labels <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "O2",
  "Outcome-8" = "O8"
)

exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Situation = factor(Situation, levels = situation_levels),
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels)
  )

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Situation, Outcome) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(.data[[dv_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(.data[[dv_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.data[[dv_col]]))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    bar_fill_group = if_else(
      Situation == "Uncertain",
      "empty",
      as.character(Outcome)
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 3. Paired subject data
# ============================================================

paired_data <- exp_data %>%
  select(
    Subject = all_of(sub_col),
    Situation,
    Outcome,
    Value = all_of(dv_col)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Outcome,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    situation_num = as.numeric(Situation),
    x = situation_num - bar_interval / 4,
    x_end = situation_num + bar_interval / 4,
    y = `Outcome-2`,
    y_end = `Outcome-8`
  )

point_data <- paired_data %>%
  select(Subject, Situation, `Outcome-2`, `Outcome-8`, x, x_end) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Outcome-2`, `Outcome-8`),
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels),
    x_point = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ x,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ x_end
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Mean values for significance annotations
# ============================================================

uncertain_outcome8_mean <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Situation == "Uncertain", Outcome == "Outcome-8") %>%
  pull(mean_value)

certain_outcome8_mean <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Situation == "Certain", Outcome == "Outcome-8") %>%
  pull(mean_value)

sig_uncertain_y <- uncertain_outcome8_mean + sig_y_offset
sig_certain_y <- certain_outcome8_mean + sig_y_offset


# ============================================================
# 5. Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot() +

  geom_col(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = mean_value,
      fill = bar_fill_group,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = bar_width,
    linewidth = border_size,
    position = bar_position
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = bar_fill_palette,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = bar_color_palette,
    name = ""
  ) +
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  geom_point(
    data = point_data,
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = Value,
      fill = Outcome
    ),
    shape = point_shape,
    size = point_size,
    stroke = point_stroke,
    color = "transparent",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = point_fill_palette,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se,
      group = Outcome
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth,
    position = bar_position
  ) +

  # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_fill_palette, guide = "none") +
  # scale_color_manual(values = outcome_color_palette, name = "") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = situation_labels) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(y_expand_lower, y_expand_upper))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = x_title,
    y = y_title
  ) +

  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +

  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()



```

```{r data directory}

data_dir <- file.path("..", "figs_data", "EXP4_CMB_data_260326.xlsx")
```

## Allocation
```{r EXP4 Gratitude}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'Alloc_long')
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome != "Cost-5/Uncertain", ]
# exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation != "Ambiguous", ]

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Value, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')
# 
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(exp_data, dv = "Value", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Outcome")) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Situation")) %>%
  EMMEANS("Outcome", by = "Situation") %>%
  EMMEANS("Situation", by = "Outcome") 

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}

exp3_data$Cost <- as.factor(exp3_data$Cost)

# 计算每组的平均值和标准误差
summary_data <- exp3_data %>%
  group_by(Cost) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(Value,,na.rm=T), se = sd(Value) / sqrt(length(Value)))

summary_data$exp <- 'mean'

sig1_y <- 102
sig2_y <- 107
sig3_y <- 116
sig_seg_margin <- 1.5
ns_seg_margin <- 6

cost2_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Cost == "Cost-2", "mean_value"][1])
cost28_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Cost == "Cost-2/8", "mean_value"][1])
cost8_mean <- as.double(summary_data[summary_data$Cost == "Cost-8", "mean_value"][1])

p1 <- ggplot()+
  # 绘制条形图和标准误差
  geom_bar(data = summary_data, stat = "identity", aes(x = Cost, y = mean_value),
           fill = c("#FFD06F", "#EF8A47", "#E76254"), width = bar_width) +
  
  # worse rect
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = 2+bar_width/2, ymin = cost2_mean, ymax = cost28_mean), fill = '#FDE4B1', alpha = 0.4)+

  # better rect
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = 3-bar_width/2, ymin = cost28_mean, ymax = cost8_mean), fill = '#FFC8C2', alpha = 0.4)+
  
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost2_mean, xend = 1+bar_width/2, yend = cost2_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#E19A00", size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost28_mean, xend = 2+bar_width/2, yend = cost28_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#B95614", size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, y = cost8_mean, xend = 3+bar_width/2, yend = cost8_mean),
               linetype = "longdash", color = "#C05145", size = 2) +

  geom_line(data = exp3_data, aes(x=Cost, y=Value, group = ID), 
            color = "#555555", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "longdash", size = 1.5) +

  geom_point(data = exp3_data, aes(x=Cost, y=Value),size = 3, color = "#A0A0A0") +
  
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_data, aes(x = Cost, ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
                width = 0.2,  # 调整errorbar的宽度
                position = position_dodge(0.7), size = 2.5) +  # 与条形图对齐
  
  xlab("Outcome")+#横坐标名称
  ylab("Gratitude")+#纵坐标名称
  theme_classic() + #去掉背景灰色
  theme(  
    axis.title = element_text(size = title_size),  # 设置坐标轴名称的大小为100
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 2),

    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = title_margin)),  # 调整y轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = title_margin)),  # 调整x轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = text_margin)),   # 调整y轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = text_margin))    # 调整x轴刻度与轴线的距离
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 120), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Cost-2" = "U2", "Cost-2/8" = "UU", "Cost-8" = "U8")) +
  

  
  # geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = sig1_y, yend = sig1_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  # geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = sig1_y + ns_seg_margin, label = "n.s."), color = "black", size = sig_ns_size) +  # 显著性值
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 3, y = sig2_y, yend = sig2_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 2.5, y = sig2_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) + # 显著性值
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 3, y = sig3_y, yend = sig3_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 2, y = sig3_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) # 显著性值


# ggsave(".\\results\\exp3_grati_avova_241226.pdf", device = cairo_pdf, plot = p1, width = width_in_inches, height = height_in_inches, units = "in")
ggsave(".\\results\\exp3_cost_grati_avova_250410.svg", plot = p1, width = width_in_inches, height = height_in_inches, units = "in")

```

# Intention
```{r exp3 Intention-mix}
# 读取 Excel 文件
exp_data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'exp2_Inten')

#### 提取risky下三个情境的Gratitude/Allocation
exp3_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Risky' & exp_data$Cost == 'Cost-8'& exp_data$Stage == 'After',]

tmp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Risky' & exp_data$Cost == 'Cost-2'& exp_data$Stage == 'After',]
exp3_data <- rbind(exp3_data, tmp_data)

tmp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Risky' & exp_data$Cost == 'Cost-2/8'& exp_data$Stage == 'Before',]
exp3_data <- rbind(exp3_data, tmp_data)
####

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp3】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp3_data$Value, list(exp3_data$Cost), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp3_data$Value, list(exp3_data$Cost), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')
# 
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(exp3_data, dv = "Value", subID = "ID", within = c("Cost"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Cost"))

```

```{r, echo=TRUE}
  geom_text(aes(x = 2, y = sig3_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "*"), color = "black", size = sig_size) # 显著性值
```

## Alloc
```{r EXP3_PMPD Gratitude}
# 读取 Excel 文件
data <- read_excel(data_dir, sheet = 'exp7_Alloc')
exp_data <- data[data$Outcome != "Outcome-5", ]
# exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation != "Ambiguous", ]

### one-factor ANOVA
print('【Exp7】')

# 使用tapply计算平均值和标准差 
means <- tapply(exp_data$Rating, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), mean)
std_devs <- tapply(exp_data$Rating, list(exp_data$Outcome, exp_data$Situation), sd)
cat("Means:", means, '\n')
cat("Standard Deviations:", std_devs, '\n')
# 
# 执行单因素方差分析
MANOVA(exp_data, dv = "Rating", subID = "SubID", within = c("Outcome","Situation"), sph.correction = 'GG') %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Outcome")) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = c("Situation")) %>%
  EMMEANS("Outcome", by = "Situation") %>%
  EMMEANS("Situation", by = "Outcome") 

```


### fig
```{r, echo=TRUE}
output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\03_exp7_alloc_situation_avova_260621.svg"

# ============================================================
# 3. Axis labels and y-axis
# ============================================================

x_title <- "Situation"
y_title <- "Alloc-Cost"

y_min <- 0
y_max <- 20
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 20
y_break_by <- 5


# sig1_y <- 99
# sig2_y <- 99
# sig3_y <- 105
# sig_seg_margin <- 1.5

# ============================================================
# 2. Data columns and factor settings
# ============================================================

sub_col <- "SubID"
dv_col <- "Rating"

situation_levels <- c("Uncertain", "Certain")
outcome_levels <- c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8")

# situation_labels <- c(
#   "Uncertain" = "Uncertain-\nto-Certain",
#   "Certain" = "Constantly-\nCertain"
# )
situation_labels <- c(
  "Uncertain" = "Uncertain",
  "Certain" = "Certain"
)
outcome_labels <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "O2",
  "Outcome-8" = "O8"
)

exp_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    Situation = factor(Situation, levels = situation_levels),
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels)
  )

summary_data <- exp_data %>%
  group_by(Situation, Outcome) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(.data[[dv_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(.data[[dv_col]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.data[[dv_col]]))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(
    bar_fill_group = if_else(
      Situation == "Uncertain",
      "empty",
      as.character(Outcome)
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 3. Paired subject data
# ============================================================

paired_data <- exp_data %>%
  select(
    Subject = all_of(sub_col),
    Situation,
    Outcome,
    Value = all_of(dv_col)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Outcome,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    situation_num = as.numeric(Situation),
    x = situation_num - bar_interval / 4,
    x_end = situation_num + bar_interval / 4,
    y = `Outcome-2`,
    y_end = `Outcome-8`
  )

point_data <- paired_data %>%
  select(Subject, Situation, `Outcome-2`, `Outcome-8`, x, x_end) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Outcome-2`, `Outcome-8`),
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = outcome_levels),
    x_point = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ x,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ x_end
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. Mean values for significance annotations
# ============================================================

uncertain_outcome8_mean <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Situation == "Uncertain", Outcome == "Outcome-8") %>%
  pull(mean_value)

certain_outcome8_mean <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Situation == "Certain", Outcome == "Outcome-8") %>%
  pull(mean_value)

sig_uncertain_y <- uncertain_outcome8_mean + sig_y_offset
sig_certain_y <- certain_outcome8_mean + sig_y_offset


# ============================================================
# 5. Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot() +

  geom_col(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      y = mean_value,
      fill = bar_fill_group,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = bar_width,
    linewidth = border_size,
    position = bar_position
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = bar_fill_palette,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = bar_color_palette,
    name = ""
  ) +
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  geom_point(
    data = point_data,
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = Value,
      fill = Outcome
    ),
    shape = point_shape,
    size = point_size,
    stroke = point_stroke,
    color = "transparent",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = point_fill_palette,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_data,
    aes(
      x = Situation,
      ymin = mean_value - se,
      ymax = mean_value + se,
      group = Outcome
    ),
    width = errorbar_width,
    linewidth = errorbar_linewidth,
    position = bar_position
  ) +

  # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_fill_palette, guide = "none") +
  # scale_color_manual(values = outcome_color_palette, name = "") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = situation_labels) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(y_expand_lower, y_expand_upper))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = x_title,
    y = y_title
  ) +

  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +

  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()



```
